data.acquisitionSummary: AIS currently advertises the SIM2Fly 1-Year Global roaming SIM at 2,699 baht promotional price (regular/terms price 2,799) for 15GB over 365 days. SIM2Fly can first-activate in Thailand or a supported destination including China, but SIM registration/identity verification is required and long-term continuous roaming has explicit limitations.

keep.action: AIS says topping up can add SIM validity and On-Top packages can add validity days, but the reviewed current sources do not establish the cheapest durable number-retention top-up ladder beyond the packaged validity. Do not treat the 365-day data-package price as the minimum annual keep-alive cost.

data.chinaActivation: First activation is allowed in Thailand or any supported SIM2Fly country; China (including Tibet) is listed for the Global package. The activated SIM must be used in a designated country within 60 days or the roaming package can be voided. Identity registration still applies.
data.kyc: SIM registration is required. AIS states all mobile numbers must be registered; foreign nationals can use passport information for registration/verification. The prior passport-free wording is removed.
data.payment: SIM2Fly is sold through AIS online and retail channels; exact foreign-card acceptance for the selected purchase channel should be verified at checkout.
data.wifiCalling: Not relied on for this route decision.
data.roamingSms: AIS SIM2Fly documentation says calls and SMS can be received normally while abroad, and China is a supported destination. However, AIS reserves the right to suspend roaming after more than 60 days of continuous roaming, so long-term inbound SMS/OTP continuity must not be assumed.
data.holdReason: HOLD for long-term overseas number-retention/OTP use: exact minimum post-package number-retention economics are unresolved and AIS reserves the right to suspend roaming after more than 60 days of continuous roaming. Identity registration is also required.
data.tariffSummary: Current 1-Year Global card shows 2,699 THB promo versus 2,799 THB terms price for 15GB/365d. This is a roaming-data product price, not a proven minimum annual number-retention cost.
guideSteps: Complete AIS SIM registration/identity verification; foreign nationals should expect passport-based verification.
First-activate in Thailand or a supported SIM2Fly destination such as China and use it in a designated country within 60 days.
Do not rely on continuous roaming beyond 60 days or on a fixed post-year keep-alive cost until AIS publishes/validates the relevant retention mechanics.
